facts.what: The message count for the ready mark

places.quote: The ready mark comes at 100 main messages.
A stop after 100 new messages sends the ready mark.

facts.what: The range of the repeat option

places.quote: The repeat count is a whole number from 1 to 3.
Use `--repeat 3` or less.

facts.what: The recoveries in one turn

places.quote: A turn allows one recovery.
There is at most one recovery in a turn.

facts.what: The first end date that the checker accepts

places.quote: The checker rejects an end date before 2090.
The check fails when the end date is before 2090-01-01.

facts.what: When an agent can commit

places.quote: An agent makes no commit unless asked.
Commit only when the driver tells you to.

facts.what: The tool has no dependencies

places.quote: The tool has no dependencies.
Do not add npm dependencies to the tool.

facts.what: No long dashes in a text

places.quote: Write with no em dashes.
Do not use long dashes in a text.

facts.what: The default of the index mode

places.quote: `"index": "code"` is the default, and `"claude"` is the off switch.
`"index": "claude"` in the settings file switches back.

facts.what: The address of the home server

places.quote: The home server has the address `casa.example.org`.
The tunnel sends `https://casa.example.org` to `127.0.0.1:4321`.

facts.what: The scope of the plugin install

places.quote: Install the plugin with `--scope local`.
The plugin is installed in each project folder with `--scope local`.
The plugin is installed per project with `--scope local`, never for the user.

facts.what: Where the remove command deletes a folder

places.quote: The remove command deletes a folder only when it is under `EXAMPLE_BOOKS_DIR`.
The remove command deletes a folder when it is under `~/example-books`.

facts.what: A second run replaces the first

places.quote: A second run for the same commit replaces the first run.
A second run for the same commit folder replaces the earlier run.

facts.what: The capture switch is off by default

places.quote: The capture switch is off by default.
With the capture switch off (the default), the tool sends nothing.

facts.what: The line limit of the journal

places.quote: Keep the journal under 60 lines.
The journal has at most 80 lines.

facts.what: The Node version of the toolchain

places.quote: The toolchain is Node `24.22.1` (`.nvmrc`).
Use Node from `.nvmrc` (`24.21.0`) in each shell.

facts.what: The default of the capture mode

places.quote: The default of `mode` stays `"steps"`, and the old projects stay on `"two-calls"`.
The code default of the mode is `two-calls` (one project ran steps and failed).

facts.what: The public variables of the dev file

places.quote: The dev file holds `API_URL`, `PROJECT_ID`, `MODEL_ID`, `LOG_HOST` and `LOG_KEY`.
Public variables: `API_URL`, `PROJECT_ID`, `MODEL_ID`, `LOG_HOST`, `LOG_KEY`, `TRIGGER_TOKENS`.

facts.what: How long a token is valid

places.quote: A token is valid for 30 days.
A token is valid for about 4 weeks.

facts.what: The count of the settings

places.quote: The settings file holds five settings.
The settings file has 5 settings in one block.

facts.what: The groups that a page shows

places.quote: The index page lists the top 8 groups.
A profile page shows the top 8 groups of a city.
The share page shows the top 10 groups.

facts.what: The tries of a download

places.quote: A download gets 1 to 3 tries.
The tool tries a download 1-3 times.

facts.what: The Node line of the server

places.quote: The server runs on Node 24.
The server image has Node 24.22.1.

facts.what: The wait between two tries

places.quote: Wait 1 second between two tries.
Wait 1.5 seconds between two tries.

facts.what: Which run the report keeps

places.quote: The report keeps the 1st run.
The report keeps the 2nd run.

facts.what: What the agent says before a deploy

places.quote: Say "ask the owner before you run the deploy script" first.
Say "tell the owner before you run the deploy script" first.

facts.what: The time limit of a call

places.quote: A call stops after 60s.
A call stops after 60 seconds.

facts.what: The row limit of an export

places.quote: An export holds 10,000 rows at most.
An export holds up to 10000 rows.

facts.what: The address of the status page

places.quote: The status page is at `status.example.org`.
Open `https://status.example.org:8443` for the status page.

facts.what: The file with the release notes

places.quote: The release notes are in `notes.md`.
Write each release in `docs/notes.md`.

facts.what: The groups of a short list

places.quote: A short list holds the top-8 groups.
A short list has the top 8 groups only.

facts.what: The mode of the night runs

places.quote: A night run sets `mode=fast`.
The night runs use `mode=full`.
